```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Count the number of dogs by breed
breed_counts = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10)

# Create a bar plot for the top 10 dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.index, y=breed_counts.values, palette='viridis')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Dog Breeds', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
